title: BPP episode_request request (DESIGN.md §11.2, §14.8; registry R29 participant)
description: Mutation (meta required). Requests an Episode from the owner intent chain: the caller supplies the exact WakeIntent and ActivationAdmission refs; manifestation, context manifest, resource allocation, and placement fields are kernel/saga-derived and no stage can be skipped (§11.1, §14.8: queue only after both reservations) — gap note G27. Eligibility is deterministic; no raw message or Kovee attention candidate starts an Episode (§11.2). generation is the R29 generation fence.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

class.description: Digest class per the §14.2 table; substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_id.description: Key id for keyed classes (raw HMAC keys and per-object salts are never part of a DigestRef).

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef (§14.2): every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash.

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; update operations additionally supply expected_revision (registry rule enforced in code, not expressible here).
